responsibility: This definition module declares the DynamicStrings-based command-string argument parser. It belongs to the gm2 string utility layer and exports GetArg and Narg for extracting and counting arguments embedded in a single String command line, providing the String analogue of CmdArgs.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the exported interface for the SCmdArgs pair: it declares String-based argument extraction from a command-line string, while SCmdArgs.mod contains the actual whitespace/quote scanning logic that finds and slices each argument.
